properties.description: Ever Gauzy (ever-co/ever-gauzy) is an open-source, enterprise-grade Business Management Platform, ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and Project Management ecosystem tailored for modern digital agencies, software consultancies, and remote workforce operations. Built on a modular full-stack TypeScript architecture using NestJS, Angular, and Nx monorepo tooling, it consolidates core operational verticals into a unified platform. Key features include real-time employee time tracking, activity and productivity monitoring, desktop timer integration, automated screenshots, leave management, automated payroll processing, and profit-sharing calculations. The system manages full CRM customer contact lifecycles, lead pipelines, deal tracking, and recruitment workflows via an integrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS). On the financial and accounting side, Ever Gauzy handles ERP invoicing, client billing, expense tracking, recurring payments, and multi-currency reporting. For project execution, it provides Kanban task management, sprint planning, employee velocity monitoring, organizational goals, OKRs, and KPI dashboards. Supported by multi-tenant workspace isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), multi-database connectivity (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite), and REST/GraphQL APIs, it integrates seamlessly with external identity providers and billing services.
